C-REFLECT-SESSION-PART-EXTRACTOR.IntentSummary: Restore vv-reflect's mechanical pre-pass on post-migration sessions: join session_part tool entries and assistant text for rows with empty inline content in tree mode, add session_part calls to the archive call union by call id with session_message winning, update the storage-model docstring, extend the synthetic suite for both modes, and prove the fix live on the measured session before shipping a new PR reviewed by an unprimed subagent.

T-001.Title: Join session_part in the extractor: tree-mode tool entries and tails, archive calls, docstring.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: session_messages selects the message id, and a part loader reads the session's session_part rows grouped by message_id in ordinal order once per session.

tool_entries uses a row's inline content when it is a non-empty list and otherwise the row's session_part tool entries; message_tail joins assistant text from session_part type='text' parts when inline content yields none; user rows and reasoning/tool parts stay unchanged.
archive_calls scans session_part tool rows and adds calls by data.id only for ids absent from the session_message and legacy part scans, keeping session_message-wins precedence.
The module docstring describes the three-store model (legacy part subset, inline session_message content, post-migration session_part).

T-002.Title: Extend the synthetic suite with post-migration fixtures for tree and archive modes.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The tree fixture adds a session whose assistant rows carry empty inline content with session_part rows (reasoning, text, edit and read tool parts): stats count the session_part tools, files include the edit path and exclude the read path, and the tail carries the assistant text from parts.
The archive fixture asserts calls from session_part are counted once, that inline and legacy-part calls are not double-counted, and that a session without session_part rows keeps its aggregate.
The existing fixtures and assertions stay unchanged as regression pins.

T-003.Title: Run gates and the live re-measurement, reconcile projections, archive, and open the PR.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The grace lint baseline, target, and final assertion gates pass for this change, and bun run check, build, and pack:check pass fresh.

The live smoke re-run over the measured post-migration session returns non-zero tool calls, a non-empty files list, and a non-empty tail; the command, numbers, and date are recorded in the bundle's smoke-evidence.md.

The M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS graph purpose and the V-M-CLI-MANAGED-SKILLS scenario truthfully cover the session_part reads for the reflect extractor; the bundle is archived with applied statuses before the commit, and a PR is opened from the branch for unprimed subagent review.
